extra.reason: Implemented and validated against real images; commit incoming
Implemented native tar detect+unpack; validated on real TR6S/TR8S/T8 update files (byte-identical extraction, path-safe, prefix-stripped). 6 tests pass.

App_Panel RE done in Ghidra: toolchain = STM32Cube HAL + GCC/newlib; peripheral map from IRQ table (USART1/ADC+DMA/EXTI/TIM1,3,14, no SPI); panel<->BMC protocol = MIDI-over-UART (Note On/Off ch0/1/3, Active Sensing keepalive, 3-byte packets, DMA ping-pong TX). Documented in firmware-format.md; functions renamed + plate-commented in the Ghidra DB.

Resolved: there is NO per-record checksum. The +0x08 field is zero for all records except record 0 of each section (kits/patterns 1-127 all zero) — it's a single section-level token in record 0, not a per-record hash. So editing user slots (records >=1) is checksum-free; tr-studio writes to user slots need no recomputation. Record-0 token algorithm unresolved (not std CRC/hash; TR Editor CheckSum is the SysEx one) and only matters if editing slot 0 / if device verifies section integrity — settle by device test. Documented in docs/tr-format.md.

Step word fully decoded: byte0=velocity, byte1 bits0-2=sub step (1=FLAM, 2=1/2, 3=1/3, 4=1/4 — a hit count, not the Script.xml combo index; proven by an 11x enrichment of value 1 in patterns with non-default FLAM SPACING, p~7e-4), byte1 bit7=ALTERNATE. Also solved the 25-slot map as a side effect (only 12 slots are step tracks; 12-24 are motion). Shipped SubStep/StepWord accessors + bit-preserving setters + track_role() in tr-format, StepGrid sub-step/alt support in tr-studio, 8 new tests, docs. Probability bits split out to cowbell-j6b.5.

Motion lane map solved via Script.xml's motionPrm dataTable, where <order> is the byte index within the 4-byte PRM word: INST slots 12-22 = TUNE/DECAY/CTRL, slot 23 (OTH0) = DELAY FEEDBACK/LEVEL/TIME, slot 24 (OTH1) = REVERB LEVEL/MFX SW/MFX DEPTH. The RVB/DLY/MFX split is forced by order collisions and confirmed empirically (slot 24 lane 1 is the only strictly-binary lane in the backup = MFX SW, max 1). Validated 127/128 against the manifest's 'Motion ON' flag. Flags byte bits 7/6 = lane0/lane1 recorded (0 violations in 8933 words). Shipped MotionWord/motion_lane_name/Pattern::motion_word in tr-format, MotionLanes + 'tr-studio motion' CLI. Remaining flags-byte work split to cowbell-j6b.6.
